pairs.description: Curcumin in turmeric inhibits intestinal efflux transporters, significantly increasing plasma concentrations of sulfasalazine.
pairs.mechanism: Inhibition of Breast Cancer Resistance Protein (BCRP/ABCG2) in the enteric lumen decreasing drug efflux.

pairs.description: Turmeric intake can elevate systemic levels of tacrolimus, necessitating therapeutic drug monitoring to prevent calcineurin nephrotoxicity.
pairs.mechanism: Inhibition of P-glycoprotein efflux transport and intestinal CYP3A4 by curcuminoids.

pairs.description: Turmeric and curcumin demonstrate mild anticoagulant effects that may synergize with warfarin to increase hemorrhage danger.
pairs.mechanism: Inhibition of thrombin and activated factor Xa combined with suppression of platelet aggregation.
